8/ Tactics don't matter in the absence of strategy. That's why the "tactic" of killing thousands of North Vietnamese or Taliban did nothing but help our enemy. The tactics didn't serve a strategy.

Same thing in Iran. Our tactics are failing and that's why Iran is succeeding.

7/ The war will create a tighter China-Iran alliance. After Trump tires of the war, Iran and China will make a deal. Part of it might be lower "tolls" on the Strait for China, in exchange for help to rebuild Iran's navy, air force, and missiles.
nytimes.com/2026/03/27/world…

6/ Rubio Objective 4: Destroy factories.

The idea is to stop them from rebuilding their military. But we can't even take out their existing missile and drone supply!

But here's the real problem. Russia/China are going to help them rebuild as soon as our bombing stops anyway.

5/ Iran hides and moves their missiles and launchers. There seems to be no way to end their ability to hit our bases (in part bc Russia is helping them with targeting) and regional energy infrastructure (their missiles are causing a global energy crisis).
nytimes.com/2026/03/29/world…

4/ Rubio Objective 3: "Diminish" their missile capacity.

First, this is a new goal. Weeks ago, Rubio said the goal was to "destroy" Iran's missiles.

Why the change? Because we are failing in the original mission. Iran still has most of their missiles.
reuters.com/world/middle-eas…

3/ Rubio Objective 2: Destroy their navy.

Ok, but for what? Their "navy" isn't what closes the Strait of Hormuz. It's thousands of speed boats and suicide boats. And like their drones, we can't destroy them all.

The Strait stays closed, navy or no navy.
foxnews.com/world/iran-deplo…

2/ Rubio objective 1: destroy their air force. 

Air power is how a nation projects extra-territorial power. And how you protect your own airspace.

But drones are replacing airplanes. And we CANNOT destroy all their drones. Their drone attacks continue.
jpost.com/middle-east/iran-n…

Here's the problem. These are all "tactical" objectives. They are not strategy. Because there IS NO strategy.
